hooks.command: $raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $j = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $j.tool_response.filePath; if (-not $f) { $f = $j.tool_input.file_path }; if ($f -and (Test-Path $f)) { $d = Split-Path -Parent $f; while ($d -and -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $d 'package.json'))) { $p = Split-Path -Parent $d; if ($p -eq $d) { $d = $null; break }; $d = $p }; if ($d) { Push-Location $d; npx prettier --write "$f" 2>&1 | Out-Null; Pop-Location } }; exit 0

if [ -f "$HOME/.claude/hooks/agent-state.sh" ]; then "$HOME/.claude/hooks/agent-state.sh" claude SessionStart; elif [ -f "$USERPROFILE/.claude/hooks/agent-state.ps1" ]; then powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$USERPROFILE/.claude/hooks/agent-state.ps1" -Agent claude -Event SessionStart; fi

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; r=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; if [ ! -f "$r/CLAUDE.md" ] && [ ! -f "$r/.claude/CLAUDE.md" ]; then if [ -f "$r/AGENTS.md" ]; then m="No CLAUDE.md in this repo. AGENTS.md exists, so add a CLAUDE.md containing @AGENTS.md for Claude to read it."; else m="No CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md in this repo. Run /init to create one."; fi; printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"%s"}}\n' "$m" "$m"; fi

if [ -f "$HOME/.claude/hooks/agent-state.sh" ]; then "$HOME/.claude/hooks/agent-state.sh" claude UserPromptSubmit; elif [ -f "$USERPROFILE/.claude/hooks/agent-state.ps1" ]; then powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$USERPROFILE/.claude/hooks/agent-state.ps1" -Agent claude -Event UserPromptSubmit; fi

if [ -f "$HOME/.claude/hooks/agent-state.sh" ]; then "$HOME/.claude/hooks/agent-state.sh" claude Stop; elif [ -f "$USERPROFILE/.claude/hooks/agent-state.ps1" ]; then powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$USERPROFILE/.claude/hooks/agent-state.ps1" -Agent claude -Event Stop; fi

if [ -f "$HOME/.claude/hooks/agent-state.sh" ]; then "$HOME/.claude/hooks/agent-state.sh" claude StopFailure; elif [ -f "$USERPROFILE/.claude/hooks/agent-state.ps1" ]; then powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$USERPROFILE/.claude/hooks/agent-state.ps1" -Agent claude -Event StopFailure; fi
